name: Bloom Dissolve
description: The highlights of the first clip blow out into a soft, wide glow that floods the frame; under it the second clip takes over, then the glow subsides into its highlights. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: spread
params.description: Reach of the glow at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: threshold
params.description: Brightness above which the picture glows (the whole frame does at the peak)

params.name: tint
params.description: Tint of the glow, toward its edges
